components.finding: EO13881 section3 supersedes EO10582 only to extent inconsistent; it conditionally revokes exactly sections2(a) and2(c) upon final-rule issuance. EO14005 section14(b) again supersedes10582 and13881 only to extent inconsistent. Section14(a) uses express revocation for other orders; the distinction is material.

DFARS2022 operative225.003/.101 amendments at87FR37443 change domestic-content definitions. Its background summary at37440 must be read within the express presidential scope inEO13881 section3 andEO14005 section14(b). It supplies evidence of implementation, without independently changing every10582 provision.

FAR2019-016 final exists by publicationJanuary19 2021; effectiveJanuary21 and solicitation/resultant-contract applicabilityFebruary22 are different. The final satisfies the section3 trigger; precise issuance/earlier inconsistency ending is not established by transplanting any one of those dates. Filing stampJanuary15 is evidence to investigate, not automatically presidential trigger date.

20CFR654.11–.13 affirmatively implements the Labor responsibilities under10582; FY2027 DOL notice91FR56217 actually classifies areas effectiveOctober1 2026, for the fiscal year throughSeptember30 2027. These are not merely historical citations. They do not alone satisfy10582 section3(c)’s presidential-national-interest-period and nonexcessive-price conditions or prove whole-order YES.

EO11051 section603(e) changes section3(d) adviser and adds national-security clear-showing standard. EO12148 section5-203 substitutes FEMA Director and section6 expressly effectiveJuly15 1979, distinct from July20 signing/July24 publication. EO12608 section2 substitutes OMB for Bureau of Budget and includes10582. EO10761 section5 excludes petroleum, with section6 contract applicability30days afterMarch27 1958.
